verdict.rationale: Convertio documents broad cross-format conversion (more than 25,600 conversions across 300+ formats) and a dedicated Ebook Converter. However, none of the evidence names Markdown, HTML, LaTeX, EPUB or DOCX, so whether these specific pairs convert between each other is only implied. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of Markdown/LaTeX/HTML/EPUB/DOCX support, documentation of which directions between them are supported, evidence of conversion fidelity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
